info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Connelli Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Connelli Battery Details Management API enables users to enrich the catalog of Connelli batteries by adding detailed information. It supports the input of various attributes related to each battery, ensuring comprehensive data management. Primary consumers of this API include inventory managers and catalog administrators who require precise battery specifications for better product offerings. This API streamlines the process of catalog expansion, enhancing overall product visibility and customer satisfaction.

post.summary: Create a new Connelli Battery detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for a Connelli Battery. Make sure to provide all necessary information in the request body to successfully add a new entry.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details required to create or update a Connelli battery's information. It must adhere to the specified JSON schema.

connelli_battery_id.description: Unique identifier for the Connelli battery.

requestedBy.description: Name or identifier of the person requesting the operation.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: Unit price of the Connelli battery.

dimensions.description: Dimensions of the Connelli battery, including width, height, and unit.

supplier.description: Details about the supplier of the Connelli battery.

CreateCatalogConnelliBatteryDetailReques.description: Request body schema for operations related to Connelli battery details in a POST request.

width.description: Width of the battery in specified units.

height.description: Height of the battery in specified units.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the dimensions (e.g., cm, inches).

Dimensions.description: Schema representing the dimensions of the Connelli battery.

verified.description: Indicates whether the supplier has been verified.

Supplier.description: Schema representing the supplier details for the Connelli battery.

email.description: Email address of the supplier's contact.

phone.description: Phone number of the supplier's contact.

Contact.description: Schema representing the contact information of the supplier.

CreateCatalogConnelliBatteryDetailRespon.title: Battery Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the record created during the operation.

processedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the criteria for this operation.

pricing.description: Detailed pricing information related to the operation.

CreateCatalogConnelliBatteryDetailRespon.description: Response schema for the battery operation process which includes the status of the operation and pricing details.

PricingDetails.title: Pricing Information

net.description: The net price for the operation.

currency.description: The currency in which the pricing is denoted.

taxIncluded.description: Indicates if taxes are included in the net pricing.

PricingDetails.description: Schema representing the pricing details for the operation including net price, currency, and tax information.

content-type.description: Specifies the media type of the resource returned in the response. This indicates the format of the data, which is generally 'application/json' for JSON responses.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This reflects the server-side processing duration.
